correctness.rationale: Independent reconstruction from the published facet formula gives 60 tetrahedral facets and face vector (10,45,100,60). Replaying the stated element matching yields 103 pairs and exactly one critical vertex, six critical two-cells and two critical three-cells; orienting all 630 Hasse covers verifies acyclicity. Exact rational boundary ranks are 9, 36 and 58, so the Betti vector is (1,0,6,2). In the resulting Morse CW complex the two-skeleton is a wedge of six two-spheres, and rank zero of the integral three-to-two cellular boundary makes both attaching classes zero in H2; Hurewicz for the simply connected two-skeleton then makes both attaching maps null. This proves the stated wedge, not merely its homology.

final_claim: The generalized Tonnetz Tonn^{10,4}(1,2,3,4) is homotopy equivalent to a wedge of six two-spheres and two three-spheres, giving the smallest all-distinct positive four-length vector as a nongeneric counterexample to replacing subset-sum genericity by pairwise distinctness.
limitations: This is one exact nongeneric four-length complex, not a classification of all nongeneric Tonnetze.
